_comment: Day cycle + procedural weather tuning (UE-only; docs/systems/environment-weather.md, Data/EnvironmentTuning, struct FEnvironmentConfig). Unreal is the master copy. *_hour = game clock hours (0..24); *_real_seconds and weather_transition_seconds = REAL seconds; weather_dwell_phase_fraction = share of the real duration of the phase a weather state started in; start_weight_* = relative weights of the random start weather; *_step_up_chance = 0..1 chance to step UP the ladder (else down). Cold (phase 2): open-air cold is multiplied by cold_mult_<weather> x cold_mult_<phase> (the weather part is blended through a transition); the weather multiplier applies to zones up to Standard, and a hand-placed Blizzard camera zone already models a storm, so the zone gets max(zone, weather) and never zone x weather; cold_on_locked_levels = false keeps the locked Demo 01 tutorial free of these multipliers. Roster (phase 2): per spawn entry, a pair's 'from' type whose suitability (0..4, 16 scores per type, order = weather Clear/Overcast/Snowfall/Blizzard, each [EarlyMorning, Midday, Afternoon, Night]) is below all_below is swapped entirely, below half_below by half, into 'ratio' x the 'to' type, and a bonus_types type above bonus_above gets count x bonus_multiplier; types without a suitability row (bosses) never change. Snow cover (phase 4): FEnvironmentState.snow_amount 0..1 grows by snow_cover_rate_snowfall / snow_cover_rate_blizzard per REAL second of running clock while it snows (blended through a transition; 1/480 = bare to full in ~8 min, 1/180 = ~3 min), holds in Clear / Overcast and never recedes; a fresh run starts at snow_cover_start (a level JSON environment.snow_cover overrides it). A missing key keeps the code default. Console: CodexTactics.DumpEnvironment.
